title: Hello, world
text:
I’m Joey (Wonhyung) Choi, an MSc Biology student at the University of Zurich. I work on single-cell chromatin accessibility: scATAC-seq and multiome (RNA + ATAC) sequencing. I do both the bench work and the analysis, so I call myself a wet-dry hybrid.
Outside the lab I co-founded type_, a dating app, so some posts here will be about building software too.

title: About
text:
👋 Hi, Welcome to Joey (Wonhyung) ’s world!
I’m an interdisciplinary researcher currently studying at the University of Zurich,
I am working on genomics and method development in Domcke Lab.
My interest spans on scMultiome sequencing platform (open chromatin region and transcripts) and cell linage development
About More information, please check out my CV!
Outside the lab, I enjoy hiking and cooking. I am currently also swim rookie who is eager to be swimmer.
